# Renderer budgets: maximum nanoseconds per frame for render_perf's
# production scenes (docs/benchmarks.md "Renderer runs"), enforced by
# .github/workflows/gpu-perf.yml on the self-hosted RTX 3060 Ti runner.
# Generated by scripts/render_budgets.py from
# render_perf-2026-10-22e-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json
# (many_lights_*: added 2026-11-01 from a run of those scenes alone):
# GPU entries are the recorded mean plus the 5 % allowance of CLAUDE.md
# §10.7 (50 µs floor below 0.2 ms); CPU entries are a flat 50 µs, which
# per-object work on the main thread would break.
# (many_lights_*: again 2026-11-02, with their reservoirs (ADR-0074), from a run of those scenes alone)
# render_perf-2026-11-02-many-lights-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json
# (many_lights_*: again 2026-11-02, with the occlusion the cache's light has (ADR-0075), from a run of those scenes alone)
# (lights_*: again 2026-11-02, as many_lights_*)
# (shadows_*.gpu.ao alone: again 2026-11-02, with their contact shadows (ADR-0076), from
# render_perf-2026-11-02-contact-shadows-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json. That run has no grids,
# whose slots raise rt accel in a full run: its other entries are no budgets.)
# (reflections (ADR-0077), 2026-11-03: the entries they moved by 1.5 % or more against #150's
# build and to within 3 % of their budgets, and their own passes', from
# render_perf-2026-11-03-reflections-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json with two interleaved
# rounds of grid_1k, grid_10k and lights_1k)
# (the passes that tonemap, 2026-11-10, with AgX the default tonemapper (ADR-0083): gpu.taa,
# and motion_*'s gpu.motion_blur where their TAA does not tonemap, from the mean of
# render_perf-2026-11-10-agx-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round, interleaved
# with the ACES build's; no other entry moved past its noise)
# (the passes the radiance cache's blended lookup touches (ADR-0085), 2026-11-11: gpu.vis_resolve and
# the frame (gpu, gpu.span) where it moved them 1.5 % or more against #170's build and to within 3 %
# of their budgets, from the mean of render_perf-2026-11-11-gi-blend-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json
# and its second round, interleaved with that build's)
# (every entry of the scenes budgeted here afresh 2026-11-13, on the user's word, with the image work of
# ADR-0090 to ADR-0095: gpu.gi_filter is new, gpu.taa and gpu.ao_denoise moved in every scene and the
# frames with them; the passes added since 2026-10-22 without rows have them (the masked software
# rasters, gpu.vsm_select) and gpu.vsm_alloc, which no frame runs any more, has none; the mean of two
# rounds run with the desktop still (docs/benchmarks.md "The desktop shares the GPU too"), from
# render_perf-2026-11-13-adr-0095-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round. The lod_* and
# foliage_* scenes stay without budgets, as they were)
# (every entry of the scenes budgeted here afresh 2026-11-14, on the user's word, with ADR-0096's
# ray triangles in the renderer (these scenes have none: a hit's triangle is found through one more
# branch); the mean of two rounds run with the desktop still, from
# render_perf-2026-11-14-adr-0096-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round. The lod_* and
# foliage_* scenes stay without budgets, as they were)
